_readme: Structural definitions for Aurelia Academy: facilities, dorm capacity table, study focuses, majors, club roles, Director origins, Director active roles, and Executive Protocols.

classrooms.name: Academic Hall
classrooms.effect: Boosts Morning lecture skill gains and Academic Prestige.

gym.name: Athletic Center
gym.effect: Boosts PE & Intimacy physical conditioning, security power, and unlocks Security role at Tier 3.

salon.name: Beauty Salon
salon.effect: Boosts Afternoon specialization gains (Performance, Seduction, Socialite) and Social Refinement.

living_standards.name: Living Standards
living_standards.effect: Increases nightly fatigue recovery for all enrolled students.

nightclub.name: Nightfall Club
nightclub.effect: Increases patron volume & club quality. Unlocks Lv1 Hostess/Bartender, Lv2 Dancer, Lv3 Singer, Lv4 Private Service.

bureau.name: Intelligence Bureau
bureau.effect: Raises incoming applicant quality and reveals deeper dossier insight.

Intimacy.label: Intimacy Workshop
Intimacy.desc: Trains Vaginal Service, Anal Service, and Fitness.

Service.label: Service Practicum
Service.desc: Trains Manual Service, Oral Service, and Bartending.

Rest.label: Infirmary & Rest
Rest.desc: Skips study to recover fatigue and calm arousal.

None.label: Off Duty (Rest)
None.desc: Takes the evening off to recover fatigue.

Hostess.label: Hostess
Hostess.desc: Entertains patrons with conversation, charm, and flirting at VIP booths.

Bartender.label: Bartender
Bartender.desc: Runs cocktail service and boosts tips across the club floor.

Dancer.label: Dancer
Dancer.desc: Performs spotlight routines that raise Social Refinement and patron draw.

Singer.label: Singer
Singer.desc: Commands the main stage, lifting Refinement and VIP booth generosity.

Security.label: Security
Security.desc: Polices the VIP floor and prevents costly City Infamy incidents.

Private_Service.label: Private Service
Private_Service.desc: Provides private VIP room services (Massage, Manual, Oral, Vaginal, Anal).

backgrounds.name: Disgraced Academic
backgrounds.description: A former dean who knows the curriculum inside out. +15 Intelligence, +10% Knowledge growth academy-wide.

backgrounds.name: Former Fixer
backgrounds.description: You dealt with the city's shadowed syndicate. +15 Physicality, +20% Security power & Compliance growth.

backgrounds.name: Disowned Heir
backgrounds.description: Fallen from grace, manners intact. +15 Social, +15% Etiquette growth & +10% club tips.

Academic.label: Academic Dean
Academic.desc: Your Intelligence provides +85% more bonus to all study gains.

Manager.label: Club Manager
Manager.desc: All Nightfall Club roles earn +25% base revenue.

Recruiter.label: Head Recruiter
Recruiter.desc: +15 Applicant quality and +4 candidates per queue.

protocols.name: Walking the Halls
protocols.effect: All students gain +1.5 Compliance and +3.0 Arousal during daytime/evening shifts.

protocols.name: Lead Academic Seminar
protocols.effect: Grants extra skill gains (+2.2 base) to all studying students and boosts Academic Prestige (+2.0).

protocols.name: City Consulting
protocols.effect: Earn off-site consulting funds scaled by Intelligence & Academic Prestige, and gain +1.0 Academic Prestige.

protocols.name: Targeted Counseling
protocols.effect: Reduces one student's fatigue by 40 and raises her Compliance by +7.

protocols.name: VIP Filtering
protocols.effect: Screens Evening patrons: +30% tips, +1 VIP/Hostess patron, and -35% incident risk.

protocols.name: Intimate Guidance
protocols.effect: Private one-on-one session: +8 Lust, +8 Compliance, +6 Seduction, +3 Kissing, +24 Arousal, +5 Depravity.

bars.energy: Inverse of Fatigue (100 - Fatigue). Below 30% triggers Auto-Rest (if enabled); reaching 5% or less (95+ Fatigue) causes an exhaustion collapse, cancelling her shift and hurting Compliance.
bars.arousal: Builds daily from Libido, traits, and Seduction/Intimacy classes. Exceeding 70 by Nightfall creates a chance for a Late-Night Visit to your study.
bars.depravity: Unlocks higher-tier Private Services (Manual 10+, Oral 20+, Full Intimacy 35+, Backdoor 50+) and deeper Late-Night Visit stages without reluctance penalties.
bars.rank: Overall grade (E to SSS) based on the average of a student's four innate Aptitudes.
bars.director_stamina: Fuel for Executive Protocols. Night transition automatically runs Director's Rest (+35 Stamina). Protocols costing more Stamina than you have fall back to Recess.

aptitudes.intelligence: Speeds up all daytime class skill gains (+1% per 2.5 INT over baseline) and determines overall Rank.
aptitudes.physicality: Reduces fatigue accumulated during classes and Nightfall Club shifts, helping students work longer before resting.
aptitudes.social: Directly increases tips earned across Nightfall Club roles (+0.2% per point) and contributes to overall Rank.
aptitudes.libido: Accelerates daily Arousal buildup toward Late-Night Visits and directly boosts VIP Private Service performance scores.

directorAptitudes.intelligence: Multiplies all students' daytime study gains (boosted further by +85% with Academic Dean active) and increases City Consulting income.
directorAptitudes.physicality: Adds passive Security defense against Nightfall Club incidents (+0.35 power per point) and strengthens Compliance gains from Director protocols.
directorAptitudes.social: Increases Nightfall Club tips across the floor (+0.2% per point) and improves incoming Admissions applicant quality.
directorAptitudes.libido: Amplifies Lust, Seduction, and Depravity gains during Intimate Guidance and Late-Night Visits.

skills.knowledge: Boosts Academic Prestige generated in lectures and increases Hostess conversation tips.
skills.fitness: Improves Dancer and Security club performance and reduces Evening shift fatigue.
skills.etiquette: Drives Hostess booth performance, VIP service tips, and Singer stage polish.
skills.compliance: Increases Late-Night Visit probability, unlocks VIP services & deeper Night Visit stages alongside Depravity, and supports VIP service scores.
skills.lust: Improves VIP Private Service performance & tips and increases Late-Night Visit likelihood.
skills.singing: Primary skill for Nightfall Club Singers, raising shift tier, gratuities, and Social Refinement.
skills.dancing: Primary skill for Nightfall Club Dancers, raising shift tier and unlocking extra patron draw at 45+.
skills.bartending: Primary skill for Nightfall Club Bartenders, raising shift tier and boosting floor-wide club tips.
skills.conversation: Primary skill for Hostesses and boosts Bartender drink service performance.
skills.security: Primary skill for Nightfall Security, raising shift pay and preventing costly City Infamy incidents.
skills.seduction: Boosts Hostess scores, all VIP Private Service scores, and VIP/Dancer/Singer tips.
skills.massage: Primary skill for Sensual Massage VIP encounters (tier score & revenue).
skills.kissing: Adds bonus performance score and extra tips to Hostess booths and VIP Private Services.
skills.manual_service: Primary skill for Manual Service VIP encounters (Depravity 10+ or Compliance 35+).
skills.oral_service: Primary skill for Oral Service VIP encounters (Depravity 20+ or Compliance 45+).
skills.vaginal_service: Primary skill for Full Intimacy VIP encounters (Depravity 35+ or Compliance 60+).
skills.anal_service: Primary skill for Backdoor Service VIP encounters (Depravity 50+ or Compliance 75+).

reputation.academic: Raises incoming applicant quality rolls and increases City Consulting contract fees.
reputation.refinement: Increases gratuities across the Nightfall Club floor (+0.5% tips per point).
reputation.infamy: Raises VIP base revenue (+0.4% per point), but elevates Nightfall Club incident risk unless countered by Security and VIP Filtering.
